target_definitions.treatment_response: 1 if (Post_SBP < 130 and Post_DBP < 80 mmHg) or (Delta_SBP >= 10 and Delta_DBP >= 5 mmHg); 0 otherwise.
target_definitions.delta_sbp: Systolic blood pressure reduction in mmHg (Baseline SBP - Post SBP)
target_definitions.delta_dbp: Diastolic blood pressure reduction in mmHg (Baseline DBP - Post DBP)

feature_descriptions.alcohol_intake: None, Moderate, or High alcohol consumption
feature_descriptions.dietary_sodium_mg: Estimated daily sodium intake in milligrams
feature_descriptions.family_history_htn: Family history of essential hypertension / early cardiovascular disease
feature_descriptions.hypertension_duration_years: Duration since primary hypertension diagnosis in years
feature_descriptions.baseline_sbp: Pre-treatment systolic blood pressure in mmHg
feature_descriptions.baseline_dbp: Pre-treatment diastolic blood pressure in mmHg
feature_descriptions.heart_rate: Resting heart rate in beats per minute
feature_descriptions.fasting_glucose_mg_dl: Fasting blood plasma glucose in mg/dL
feature_descriptions.proteinuria: Urinary protein assessment: Normal, Trace, Positive
feature_descriptions.ckd: Chronic Kidney Disease defined by eGFR < 60 mL/min/1.73m2 (Yes/No)
feature_descriptions.lvh: Left Ventricular Hypertrophy confirmed by ECG/Echo (Yes/No)
feature_descriptions.drug_class: Prescribed antihypertensive drug class (ACE_Inhibitor, ARB, CCB, Thiazide_Diuretic, Beta_Blocker)
